name: Tobin
text: I swear the wagon axle will be mended before the frost moon, or you may keep my hammer.

name: Odo
text: A wolf pelt fetches good money in Brask.

name: Kestra
text: Call the north road the Widow Path; nobody who walks it comes back the same.

name: Tobin
text: That cut needs more than thread.

name: Sela
text: Bring me three sprigs of moonwort and I will brew a draught that stops the fever by dawn.

name: Kestra
text: Odo loses at dice more than he wins.

name: Odo
text: Forty silver for the mule, and I throw in the saddlebags because I like your face.

name: Sela
text: The river runs red after the rains.

name: Tobin
text: My father forged the bell at Harrowgate, and it still rings a half tone flat.

name: Odo
text: A good compass is worth a month of wages.

name: Kestra
text: If the lantern goes out twice, we turn back. No arguments, no heroics.

name: Tobin
text: The pass will be snowed in within a week.

name: Sela
text: I owe the abbess at Corven a favour, and she will collect it at the worst possible moment.

name: Kestra
text: That locket has a crack along the hinge.

name: Odo
text: I never sell maps of the marsh. The last buyer drowned and his widow still writes to me.

name: Kestra
text: That axle has cracked twice since the ford.

name: Tobin
text: Give me one quiet night and a hot forge and I will make you a blade that sings.

name: Odo
text: The north road is quicker if the bridges hold.

name: Kestra
text: The ferryman takes coin from the living and buttons from the dead. Keep a button handy.

name: Tobin
text: Fever took half the drovers last winter.

name: Sela
text: Do not eat the blue mushrooms, whatever the cook says. They taste of copper and regret.

name: Kestra
text: Never pay Odo his first price for anything.

name: Odo
text: My cousin Pell runs the toll at Brask; tell him the goose sent you and he waves you through.

name: Sela
text: The Harrowgate bell woke me every morning as a girl.

name: Tobin
text: I named my anvil Grudge, because it has outlasted every one of mine.

name: Odo
text: Lantern oil costs more out here than wine.

name: Kestra
text: Wolves in this valley hunt in threes. When you see one, look for the other two behind you.

name: Tobin
text: Corven abbey has the best cellars in the valley.

name: Sela
text: I will stitch that wound once and only once. Tear it open again and you sew it yourself.

name: Kestra
text: The marsh shifts every spring anyway.

name: Odo
text: Half my profit goes to the orphan house in Lisle, and the other half goes to dice.

name: Sela
text: Nobody gets a quiet night on this road.

name: Tobin
text: The river stones here are iron-red. Smelt enough of them and you could shoe a whole army.

name: Odo
text: I sold the ferryman a crate of nails once.

name: Kestra
text: I keep my mother's compass. It points at whatever I miss most, never at north.

name: Tobin
text: The cook makes a decent stew when he is sober.

name: Sela
text: Swear on the salt that you will not leave anyone behind at the pass, Wren.

name: Kestra
text: Brask tolls doubled after the flood.

name: Odo
text: I will buy the silver locket back from you for double, the day you decide to part with it.

name: Sela
text: Tobin talks to that anvil more than to people.

name: Wren
text: What oath did Sela ask Wren to swear at the pass?

name: Kestra
text: Give me a moment to remember.

name: Wren
text: What exactly did Odo offer for the silver locket?

name: Sela
text: I think I can recall that.

name: Wren
text: What exactly did Tobin promise about the wagon axle?

name: Odo
text: Let me think back on it.

name: Wren
text: Why did Odo say he never sells maps of the marsh?

name: Sela
text: That was a while ago now.

name: Wren
text: What did Sela say about stitching the wound?

name: Kestra
text: Ask me again later if I get it wrong.

name: Wren
text: What price did Odo name for the mule?

name: Sela
text: Rain drums on the roof for a while.

name: Wren
text: What did Sela warn about the blue mushrooms?

name: Kestra
text: I think I can recall that.

name: Wren
text: What did Kestra say her mother's compass points at?

name: Tobin
text: Let me think back on it.

name: Wren
text: What did Sela say she owes the abbess?

name: Kestra
text: That was a while ago now.

name: Wren
text: What exactly did Kestra say about the wolves?

name: Tobin
text: Ask me again later if I get it wrong.

name: Wren
text: What exactly did Sela say she would brew?

name: Kestra
text: Give me a moment to remember.

name: Wren
text: What did Kestra say the ferryman takes?

name: Tobin
text: A door creaks somewhere down the hall.

name: Wren
text: What did Tobin say about the river stones?

name: Odo
text: Let me think back on it.

name: Wren
text: What was Kestra's rule about the lantern going out?

name: Tobin
text: That was a while ago now.

name: Wren
text: What did Tobin name his anvil and why?

name: Odo
text: Ask me again later if I get it wrong.

name: Wren
text: What did Kestra call the north road?

name: Tobin
text: Give me a moment to remember.

name: Wren
text: What did Tobin promise he could make with one quiet night?

name: Odo
text: I think I can recall that.

name: Wren
text: What did Odo say happens to his profit?

name: Sela
text: Rain drums on the roof for a while.

name: Wren
text: What did Tobin say about the bell his father forged?

name: Odo
text: That was a while ago now.

name: Wren
text: What password did Odo give for the toll at Brask?

name: Sela
text: Ask me again later if I get it wrong.
